turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mr. Singh from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Rohan from the Customs Clearance division. We have a high-value international shipment for you that has been flagged at the airport.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Shipment? I am not expecting any package from abroad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the documents say it contains electronics and gold coins. If you do not claim it and pay the duty now, it will be marked as illegal and reported to the police.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Police? But there must be some mistake, I have not ordered anything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we must clear this immediately to avoid a legal case. You need to pay a clearance fine of eighty thousand rupees right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand is a lot of money. How do I pay this officially?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Since it is urgent, you can just send the amount via UPI or buy Amazon gift cards and share the codes with me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Gift cards for customs? I don't understand why I would do that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the government portal is down for maintenance, so this is the only way to stop the police case. Please hurry or the parcel will be seized.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, let me talk to my son first.
